name: listing.draftId
title: Field: listing.draftId
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer-visible listing.draftId field.
meaning: Identifier of the draft from which the listing was published, when available.
nullableWhen: Source draft linkage is unavailable in the returned view.

invariants.label: Lifecycle
invariants.value: Listings originate from draft flow rather than ad-hoc creation.

invariants.label: Null
invariants.value: Null means draft linkage is not available in the current response, not that draft flow does not exist.

text:
# listing.draftId

TL;DR:
- listing.draftId links the published listing back to its source draft when that linkage is available.

What it means:
- It is a lifecycle hint, not a buyer action handle.

Agent hint:
- Use it to explain listing origin, not as something a buyer tool should mutate.
